edit.description: build the chain per-test from the fixture repo's roots; drop the api.paths disclaimer

summary: Build the backlog-groomer chain under test from the roots its Dispatcher ticks against, not from this repo's

per.section: A seam gate reads what the real writer wrote

tests: the backlog-groomer chain under test is built with the roots the dispatcher ticks against
acceptance: The factory call moves out of module scope: repoRoot/flumeDir come from the fixture repo each test makes, configDir stays examples/. The EXAMPLE_PATHS constant and its 'does not read api.paths yet' disclaimer are gone.
notes: Module-scope EXAMPLE_PATHS hands the chain this repo's repoRoot/.flume while all three ticks run in a tmpdir fixture. FlumeApi.paths declares them 'by reference — the identity-same values the dispatcher was constructed with'; the file's own header claims it builds the chain 'the same way a real tick builds it'. Neither holds, and the gap is held by a prose 'yet' with no named trigger.
